newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Siloam Gleneagles rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Siloam Gleneagles rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesian medical services firm PT Siloam Gleaneagles Health Care, a unit of the Lippo Group, rose sharply on its debut on the Surabaya Stock Exchange on Wednesday, brokers said.
It rose 375 rupiah, or about 12.7 percent, to 3,325 rupiah from its offering price of 2,950 rupiah on a volume of 6.7 million shares by mid-morning, they said.
Siloam floated 47 million shares on the Surabaya Stock Exchange.
"The market response is quite good. Look at the current price, it is encouraging," a broker with a local securities firm said.
But she added the upside appeared to be limited as the stock price was considered to have peaked for now.
Lippo Securities acted as an lead underwriter for the initial public offering of Siloam Gleaneagles.
Siloam said the float proceeds of about 138.7 billion rupiah would be used to buy a stake in some hospitals in Jakarta, one hospital in Surabaya, East Java and one hospital in Bandung, West Java.
